text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen arrived.
And this time—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Brian-san isn't running.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ It's the ultimate chance!
Maya's the only one running in this race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's why I won't let it slip.
—I'm going to make sure I do what needs to be done right now.
choice_data_list: Go on and grow even more!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Eye copy☆
Just as ordered, I'm gonna stretch out nice and far♪"
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yo, you made it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, I had no reason to refuse anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So, what is it?
Calling me all the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If it's some pointless errand,
I'm never speaking to you again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, calm down.
Sharp as you are, you've probably already figured it out, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun will be running
in this Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...So what of it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmph, don't go pretending you're not interested.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You want something from that girl.
Something that will set you free.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san, did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, that's what happens when you've spent years chasing after your back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, in the end, I never did figure out what that 'something' was, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "At the very least, I noticed that you were holding something back."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And that it wouldn't be any fun if things stayed as they are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph, so that's who you pinned your hopes on?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It seemed she really had taken an interest in raising her, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ha, did you know that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That stubborn way of running, as if she didn't know the meaning of giving up...
It reminded me of a certain someone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I suppose so.
That kid's as greedy as you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell ya one more thing.
That girl's still growing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"They'd slap you across the face with all their might
for talking all spineless about things 'coming to an end.'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And when I opened my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, I'm gonna
crush ya to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Ama-san's really softened up, hasn't she?
Sending salt to the enemy and all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?
They're not enemies, they're rivals, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.
